title: feat(facek21): on B21, nu face reverse still holds k=1..3 and fails k=4..8
science: Third repeat of the face k-sweep (after #6769 on B_16 and #6785 on B_18), now on B_21(0): the sixteen arrival times and all eight bits (yes k=1,2,3; no k=4..8) are IDENTICAL to the B_18 table, so those pair times have converged and are no longer host-sensitive. Only genuinely new datum is another wall shift on a site not used by the comparison, t(18,0,0)=24 here vs 26 on B_18. Near-duplicate of #6785.
verdict_pair: face reverse by k on B_21: YES k=1,2,3; NO k=4,5,6,7,8
